post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping plugin names (str) to PluginConfig objects for all valid, non-hidden, non-__pycache__ subdirectories of plugins_dir, ordered by ascending subdirectory name. A valid plugin subdirectory is one whose contents pass PluginConfig validation (its plugin.json parses to a PluginConfig whose fields satisfy all configured validation rules). Each subdirectory that fails validation is skipped after printing its error reason; it is absent from the returned dictionary. If plugins_dir does not exist or is not a directory, returns an empty dictionary.
